permit.union: Promoters and event organizers must also contact the Bermuda Entertainment Union (bermudaentertainmentunion.com) to provide notification of the event, obtain approval and pay any required dues.
permit.eligibility: Work permits for foreign musicians/entertainers to perform at commercial locations open to the public (clubs, pubs and hotels) may be granted, provided they are advertised in the normal way.
permit.validityNote: An entertainer's permit is normally a Seasonal Work Permit of up to eight months. To keep working past it, the employer applies for a new permit by the same process, one to three months before expiry, and the performer may keep working while a timely application is pending.

sources.title: Ministry of Economy and Labour, Department of Immigration, Work Permit Policy 2025 (5 June 2025; copy held by Bernews, the gov.bm copy returning 404)
sources.said: 7.7 Musician orEntertainer Work permits for foreign musicians/entertainers to perform at commercial locations open to the public (clubs, pubs and hotels) may be granted, provided they are advertised in the normal way. The maximum period for a work permit in the entertainment industry will normally be a Seasonal Work Permit of eight (8) months. However, where a one-off large, commercial entertainment event open to the public is to be held and foreign musicians/entertainers are to be utilised, qualified Bermudian(s), Spouse(s) of Bermudians and PRC holder(s) musician(s)/entertainer(s) of the same entertainment genre must feature in the entertainment event. … Promoters and event organizers must also contact the Bermuda Entertainment Union (bermudaentertainmentunion.com) to provide notification of the event, obtain approval and pay any required dues. … Standard, Seasonal and Occasional Work Permits Thirty (30) working days

sources.title: Government of Bermuda, All Immigration Fees
sources.said: One-year standard or periodic work permit $1,015.00 … Short-term permit for a person to be engaged for a single period of 14 days or less, in professional sport or entertainment: (a) per person (up to 5 persons) $400.00 (b) per group of more than 5 persons in addition to the fee at (A) above, for each person beyond the fifth $200.00

sources.title: Government of Bermuda (Department of Immigration), Requirements for extending the term of a work permit holder (published 3 March 2016, last updated 13 April 2026)
sources.said: If an employer intends to continue to employ a work permit holder in the same job beyond the expiry date of the current work permit, they must apply for a new permit. The same process that was followed to obtain the original permit must be followed again. Applications should be submitted no less than one month and no more than three months before the current work permit expires.

note: The Work Permit Policy of 5 June 2025 (section 7.7) grants foreign musicians and entertainers work permits, normally at most a Seasonal Work Permit of eight months, advertised in the normal way; a one-off large public event must feature qualified Bermudians of the same genre and its promoter must notify the Bermuda Entertainment Union, obtain approval and pay dues. A single engagement of 14 days or less in professional entertainment has its own short-term permit fee ($400 a person). The fee schedule names no Seasonal Work Permit fee apart, so the one-year standard permit's fee is given beside the 14-day one. Bermuda's dollar is at par with the US dollar. Read 2026-11-04 on gov.bm (updated 13 April 2026): what the policy calls a renewal is a new application by the same process.
